purpose: Prospectively validate a six-scalar ordered-pair predictor of bracket-program donorward effects on a new construction with an identical completed distractor delimiter before the active pending opener.

prior_art_search.result: Cross-family feasibility passed retrospectively, but no suffix-free scalar predictor has been frozen and evaluated on untouched prompts or a third target construction.

frozen_scalar_source: Means from direct_three_value_type_substitution only; completed-then-reopened values and all fresh-corpus values are excluded.

predictions.pred_a_temporal_seal_and_native_capabili: All 72 fresh endpoints remain unopened before this receipt, every ordered pair has 12 endpoints, and native answer accuracy is at least 0.85 overall and in every ordered pair.
predictions.pred_b_fixed_vector_program_recurrence: The frozen six-vector program produces positive donorward effects on at least 0.75 of endpoints overall and within every ordered pair.
predictions.pred_c_suffix_free_scalar_prediction: The six frozen scalars predict fresh program effects at cosine at least 0.80, relative L2 at most 0.60, norm ratio 0.50 to 1.50, and sign agreement at least 0.90.
predictions.pred_d_pairwise_recurrence: Every ordered pair has positive actual effects on at least 0.75 of endpoints and median absolute scalar error no greater than 3.0 logits.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_price_and_scope: Evaluation uses at most three physical forwards over 216 examples, with zero fits, backwards, or updates. A pass predicts scalar donorward program effects only; it does not eliminate the native base activation needed to install the vector or predict full logits.

terminal_rule: predictive_screen if all gates pass; capability_stop if temporal seal is valid but native capability fails; null if capable but the vector recurrence or scalar prediction fails; invalid on hash, balance, replay, or price mismatch.
